retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast back-view portrait featuring a subject with vibrant multi-colored hair and a hand-painted denim jacket against a void-black background.
excludeWhen: the subject needs to face the camera
a detailed environmental background is necessary

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot from behind of a person with vivid, messy orange hair streaked with purple and green. They wear a faded blue denim jacket featuring white, spray-painted or hand-painted block lettering across the back. The lighting is harsh direct flash, creating deep shadows and making the subject pop against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: vibrant hair color vs. stark black background
hand-painted white text vs. faded blue denim texture
dynamic arm posing vs. static central subject
harsh flash highlights vs. deep shadow voids
coreInvariants: vivid orange hair as the primary color focus
distressed denim jacket with white lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally framed, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange hair serves as the primary visual anchor at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright hair down to the white lettering on the jacket, then follows the raised arms outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounds the subject on all sides, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the hair and high value in the white text against a zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Soft, fuzzy edges suggesting spray paint or thick brushwork
Distressed application following the folds of the fabric
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly warped by the denim's texture and movement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style vernacular lettering to maintain raw, DIY aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the DIY, industrial feel of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person from behind with messy bright orange hair and a denim jacket against a solid black background with harsh flash lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted white block lettering to the back of the denim jacket, ensuring the text warps and fades naturally with the fabric's texture and folds.

verificationChecks: Does the hair have high-saturation orange tones?
Is the text integrated into the jacket texture?

mustRedesign: Avoid legible brand logos on the jacket
Ensure the face is not visible to maintain the back-view focus
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic fabric folds affecting the text
Ensure the hair looks messy and textured, not flat
Verify the black background is deep and noise-free
Confirm the flash highlights on the denim look authentic
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Back View] + [Vibrant Hair Color] + [Distressed Denim Jacket] + [Hand-Painted White Text] + [Solid Black Background] + [Harsh Flash Lighting]
